Subject: Field expansion: approval request for 2 quota-carrying AE seats (EMEA)

Hi team,

I am requesting approval to open two quota-carrying Account Executive (AE) seats focused on the Nordics and DACH regions to support the Q3 field expansion plan. Summary below — full modeling attached (gtm_headcount_modeling_v2.xlsx) and the proposed offer bands (offer-bands-Q3-2027.pdf).

Why now:
- We have three committed POCs across DACH (totaling ~€850k ARR pipeline) with next-step dates inside 90 days.
- Current coverage ratio in DACH/Nordics is 1:20 ACV-qualified opportunities vs target 1:12. Adding two quota-carrying AEs improves coverage to ~1:13 and materially shortens closure cycle.

Proposal details:
- Role: Quota-carrying AE (Hunters) — 2 headcount, region split: 1 DACH, 1 Nordics (remote EU).
- Compensation (recommended): base £72k–90k / €75k–95k depending on market; OTE target 1.6x–1.8x for first-year ramp. See attached offer-bands-Q3-2027.pdf for banding per country.
- Hiring manager: Marcus Lin (EMEA Sales Director) — Marcus, will you own hiring & final comp sign-off?
- Impact to run-rate: modeled in spreadsheet (tab: run_rate) — fully loaded adds ~£270k annual run-rate (includes equity estimate).
- Time-to-fill: 4–6 weeks from req approval if recruiting engaged immediately.

Next steps I’m requesting today:
1) Sign-off to convert two FTE headcount slots and budget approval to proceed (Marissa to open reqs).
2) Small comp exception for Nordics band midpoint for the senior DACH AE (per attachment) if needed — flag to Comp/Finance.

Please review and reply with: APPROVE / QUESTIONS / DENY. If APPROVE, indicate any constraints (e.g., hiring freeze carve-outs, max base).

Thanks — this is time-sensitive; customers will expect a dedicated rep before demo completion.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
